description: Xero Accounting API app emulator, for integrations that bill customers, collect payments and issue refunds: OAuth tokens and connections, organisation, chart of accounts, and contacts, invoices, payments and credit notes with signed webhook events. Deliberate differences from Xero are declared in divergences.json.

resources_not_implemented: behaviour: webhook subscription disable after 24 hours and replay of held events (GAP-001)
behaviour: order and If-Modified-Since on list endpoints are accepted and ignored (GAP-002)
behaviour: summarizeErrors=false on bulk contact writes (GAP-004)
behaviour: POST /Contacts upsert by Name, which Xero does not document (GAP-007)
behaviour: OIDC discovery, the authEventId filter on GET /connections and DELETE /connections/{id} are not served (GAP-008)
behaviour: GET /Contacts/{ContactID or ContactNumber} is not served (GAP-009)
behaviour: contact fields in an invoice update, sent flag for PAID documents, allowBackorders and the default document date are not built (GAP-010)
behaviour: rate-limit headers and 429, the payroll 401 and XML responses are not built (GAP-011)
behaviour: a webhook receiver that sets cookies is not refused (GAP-012)

lifecycle.changelog:
First release of the Xero app emulator. It targets the Xero Accounting API (addressed as version 2.0), pinned to the official xero-python 15.2.0 SDK and the 19.0.0 Accounting OpenAPI specification, with Xero's developer documentation as captured on 2026-09-28. This release is targeted: it serves 18 operations, not the whole API.

### Supported
- Sign-in: authorization-code exchange, client credentials and single-use refresh-token rotation at POST /connect/token, and GET /connections
- Organisation and chart of accounts (read)
- Contacts: list with where filters, create (PUT) and update-or-create (POST), with field validation
- Invoices: list and read by ID or invoice number, create (PUT), update, void and delete (POST), update-or-create (POST), and summarizeErrors=false
- Payments: create (POST) against an invoice or a credit note, and delete by status write
- Credit notes: list, create (PUT) with inline allocations, and update-or-create (POST) including allocations
- where filters, the explicit list filters the SDK sends, and page-based pagination on the list endpoints
- Signed webhook delivery for contact, invoice and credit note events, with the intent-to-receive check; subscriptions are registered through /admin/webhooks
- A xero-tenant-id header on every accounting route, a lenient default that accepts any bearer token, client secret, authorization code and redirect URI, and --strict-auth to restore Xero's 401 and 403 answers and to check clients registered through /admin/clients and single-use authorization codes issued through /admin/authorization-codes
- State snapshots, reset and seeding through /admin, with /_xero/health and /_xero/reset as aliases for the health and reset routes

### Verified
- Official SDK xero-python 15.2.0: 36 of 36 cases against the app emulator
- Conformance suite: 10 of 10
- A 10-step raw HTTP scenario (bill, pay and refund a customer): 10 of 10
- Through LocalStack: not yet run
- Live comparison with Xero: not run

### Not modelled
- Operations and behaviours outside the list above are not served. twin-xero/twin-manifest.json lists the 64 unserved operations and 10 unbuilt behaviours, and every deliberate difference from Xero is listed in twin-xero/divergences.json

### Known issues
- Inferred from the SDK and documentation, not observed on Xero: the credit note update rules, how POST update-or-create matches an existing record, allocations against an invoice that is already PAID, and payments on credit notes
- The Idempotency-Key header is ignored, so a retried write creates a duplicate where Xero replays the first response
- The order query parameter and the If-Modified-Since header are accepted and ignored on list endpoints: every record is returned in the default order
- A failed webhook delivery is retried a fixed number of times and then dropped; a subscription is never disabled and missed events are not replayed. Each delivery carries one event, with eventType in upper case, and Xero's batching and casing are not settled
- Rate limits are not modelled: there is no 429 answer and no X-DayLimit-Remaining or X-MinLimit-Remaining header
- The 404 and 405 answers for a path or method the emulator does not serve, and the wording of the ValidationException for a value of the wrong type or a date that cannot be read, are not observed on Xero
- Tax is not computed: a line's TaxAmount is the amount sent, or 0
- A contact array with an invalid item is refused as a whole, even with summarizeErrors=false
- Not served: OIDC discovery, the authEventId filter and DELETE /connections/{id}, GET of a single contact by ID or number, prepayments and overpayments
